title: Shinonome Akito — No Way Out In Sight〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's okay. We know how long it takes to get here from Miya Girls.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What he said. Thanks for coming, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, this cafe looks pretty nice.
Great choice, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: At the same time, it feels a little strange to eat at a cafe that doesn't belong to either MEIKO or your dad, An.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. We do generally end up going to one or the other.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We wanted a change of pace, right? So, it wouldn't mean much to go to our usual hangouts.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... Anyway, Kohane, let's see what's on the menu.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. Hmm... I wonder what's recommended here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The pasta set.
They make fresh pasta here, and the flour they use is—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What is it...?
Why do you all look so surprised?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, it's just... You always get pancakes and stuff. Pasta feels totally out of left field.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just what do you think I am exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Geez...
You're making me sound like some selfish jerk who forces everyone to go where he wants.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, Akito...
We know you put a lot of thought into this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! It's totally off brand-for you!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
Who had the pasta with meat sauce, extra cheese and a soft-boiled egg on top?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, check it out!
There's so much cheese that it's completely covering up the meat sauce!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's so white that it's camouflaging the egg.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see your orders.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We did end up ordering dessert.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. And the roasted tea cake you recommended was very good, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (She didn't seem as energetic as usual when we met up earlier...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Next time, we gotta come for just dessert! I saw a section of the menu that was just parfaits!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you can apparently make your own custom parfaits with the fruits you want and everything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
Shiraishi and Azusawa seem to be feeling much better now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting us out today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shinonome.
Coming here was a great change of pace.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I needed a break just as much as you guys.
